summary: The interface generally adapts well to the cramped viewport, but the combobox menu exhibits column misalignment for list item metadata.

issues.title: Misaligned item counts
issues.description: Item counts do not align into a consistent column because the checkmark indicator displaces the count only on the selected item.
issues.evidence: The count '0' in the Inbox row is shifted left to accommodate the checkmark, whereas counts '5', '8', and '3' sit flush right.
issues.suggestion: Reserve a consistent trailing slot for the checkmark across all options.
